format: Each step: dir (host->device | device->host), endpoint (bulk_out=EP 0x03, bulk_in=EP 0x82, interrupt_in=EP 0x81, 16-byte packets), hex (exact bytes of one USB transfer), annotation. provenance: 'verhue-capture' = hex dump found in Verhue's sources (probably captured from the official editor), 'clavia-derived' = built from the Clavia v1.62 serializers, 'verhue-derived' = built from Verhue's builders, 'synthetic' = device reply invented to match the decoded layout (field values arbitrary but legal).
description: Unsolicited LED / meter data. Not responses (hdr bit 0x08 clear); never acknowledged.

steps.annotation: extended announcement, len=17 -- 0x39 dual-bit LED blink, slot A sess 0x11, start 0; LED0=1 LED1=2 LED5=3
extended message body -- 0x39 dual-bit LED blink, slot A sess 0x11, start 0; LED0=1 LED1=2 LED5=3

embedded message -- 0x3A multi-bit (VU/strip) data, slot B sess 3, start 0, 4 entries of 2 bytes. Byte order of each entry UNCERTAIN (Clavia reads a raw i386 ushort = little-endian; Verhue uses the 2nd byte as the value)
